verdict.rationale: Cooley GO publishes some jurisdiction-specific startup documents beyond the US: a UK mutual NDA form, and UK and Singapore versions of the YC Safe alongside the US version. This shows the firm does publish for non-US markets, but only thinly. The France practice page in the pack is about S-1 drafting, not French startup instruments. Missing for 10: any evidence of content on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE, jurisdiction-specific equity-incentive guidance, and broader non-US market coverage or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: Cooley GO YC Safe generator page (US; UK and Singapore versions also offered)
